transcript.text: Let me search for the SailPoint ISC transform-related tools.
Good — the preview endpoint `POST /beta/identity-profiles/identity-preview` is the way to test a transform before wiring it in. Let me get its full details alongside the auth guide.

Here is a complete walkthrough — get a token, create a transform, then preview it against a real identity before touching any identity profile.

---

## Step 1 — Get a Bearer Token

```bash
export TENANT="your-org"   # e.g. acme (no .identitynow.com)
export CLIENT_ID="..."
export CLIENT_SECRET="..."

TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST \
  "https://${TENANT}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token" \
  -d "grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=${CLIENT_ID}&client_secret=${CLIENT_SECRET}" \
  | jq -r .access_token)
```

> Credentials go in the **POST body**, never a query string.

---

## Step 2 — Create the Transform

Two examples are shown; pick one (or chain them for a concatenation-then-uppercase pipeline).

### Option A — `upper` (uppercase a single attribute)

```bash
curl -s -X POST \
  "https://${TENANT}.api.identitynow.com/v3/transforms" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "demo-upper-firstname",
    "type": "upper",
    "attributes": {
      "input": {
        "type": "accountAttribute",
        "attributes": {
          "attributeName": "firstname",
          "sourceName": "Active Directory"
        }
      }
    }
  }' | jq .
```

### Option B — `concat` (build `firstname.lastname` for a login name)

```bash
curl -s -X POST \
  "https://${TENANT}.api.identitynow.com/v3/transforms" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "demo-concat-username",
    "type": "concat",
    "attributes": {
      "values": [
        {
          "type": "accountAttribute",
          "attributes": {
            "attributeName": "firstname",
            "sourceName": "Active Directory"
          }
        },
        {
          "type": "static",
          "attributes": { "value": "." }
        },
        {
          "type": "accountAttribute",
          "attributes": {
            "attributeName": "lastname",
            "sourceName": "Active Directory"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }' | jq .
```

Save the `id` field from the response — you will need it if you want to delete or update the transform later.

---

## Step 3 — Preview the Transform Output

This endpoint evaluates the transform against a **real identity without persisting anything** — the ideal sandbox before wiring it into an identity profile.

You need:
- `identityId` — any existing identity ID (grab one from the UI URL or `GET /v3/identities`)
- An `identityAttributeConfig` block that maps an attribute name to your new transform

```bash
export IDENTITY_ID="2c9180857f823a4b017f94207f760b5c"   # replace with a real identity ID
export TRANSFORM_NAME="demo-concat-username"              # the name you chose above

curl -s -X POST \
  "https://${TENANT}.api.identitynow.com/beta/identity-profiles/identity-preview" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-SailPoint-Experimental: true" \
  -d "{
    \"identityId\": \"${IDENTITY_ID}\",
    \"identityAttributeConfig\": {
      \"enabled\": true,
      \"attributeTransforms\": [
        {
          \"identityAttributeName\": \"uid\",
          \"transformDefinition\": {
            \"type\": \"reference\",
            \"attributes\": {
              \"id\": \"${TRANSFORM_NAME}\"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }" | jq '.previewAttributes[] | select(.name == "uid")'
```

### What to look for in the response

```jsonc
{
  "name": "uid",
  "value": "alice.smith",      // ← the computed output
  "previousValue": null,
  "errorMessages": []          // ← empty means no transform errors
}
```

If `errorMessages` is non-empty the transform has a configuration problem (wrong source name, missing attribute, etc.) and needs fixing before you save it to an identity profile mapping.

---

## Key points

| Concern | Detail |
|---|---|
| Required scope (create transform) | `idn:transform:manage` |
| Required scope (preview) | `idn:identity-profile:manage` |
| Preview is non-destructive | Nothing is written; safe to call repeatedly |
| Beta header | `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true` is **required** on the preview call |
| Rate limit | 100 requests / token / 10 s; respect `Retry-After` on 429 |

---

```answer-summary

  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/transforms
    api_version: v3
  - method: POST
    path: /beta/identity-profiles/identity-preview
    api_version: beta
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token (client credentials via PAT)
required_scopes: [idn:transform:manage, idn:identity-profile:manage]

```
